subject: Mutual Action Plan: Data handling & deployment decisions — FinSecure
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@finsecure.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@finsecure.com
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 14:06:00 -0700
Subject: FinSecure MAP: deployment & retention questions

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited about the performance numbers. Procurement asked that we formalize a Mutual Action Plan to lock timelines, and they had a few early security/data-handling questions that will affect our preferred deployment mode. Quick highlights below (we attached the initial questionnaire):

- Can Redwood run in our VPC with customer-managed keys? Any blockers for a FedRAMP-adjacent assessment?
- If we go on-prem, what minimal HW footprint is required for the 4 qps eval (1k tokens/session)?
- Data retention: we need token-level retention turned off by default and a documented purge flow for PII within 30 days. Is that supported out-of-the-box?
- Will there be an audit log of inference requests that we can ingest? Format?

Procurement would like a preliminary MAP and a target close timeline (we're aiming for a decision by May 15). Can your team share a short weekly checkpoint cadence and owners so we can track?

Attached: FinSecure_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz
Director, Information Security
FinSecure
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@finsecure.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference.com>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinSecure MAP: deployment & retention questions

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear list. I've pulled together a draft MAP (attached) and proposed owners. Short answers up front, details in the MAP:

- VPC: Supported. We offer a Private control plane with customer-managed KMS; we'll need a connectivity/peering doc and a shared runbook for key rotation. No inherent blockers for a FedRAMP-style assessment, but we'll need scope discussion (control plane vs inference nodes). Owner: Lauren.
- On-prem footprint: For a 4 qps eval at ~1k tokens/session we recommend 2x A40-class GPUs (or equivalent). We'll provide a sizing matrix for alternatives (T4 / H100) linked in the MAP. Owner: Sean.
- Retention/PII: We support configurable token retention policies. By default hosted retains metrics only; for Private/VPC we can set token logging to off and enable a purge job. We'll document the purge cadence and provide sample scripts. Owner: Neha.
- Audit logs: Yes — structured JSON lines with timestamp, model, tokens, and a request id. We can expose via secure push to your SIEM or a Cloud Storage endpoint.

Action: I propose a 30-minute weekly checkpoint on Mondays to review MAP status, with the first call March 22. I've attached MAP_FinSecure_v0.3.xlsx with the initial milestones and owners.

Action items (owner):
- Lauren: Prepare KMS/connection checklist and FedRAMP scope notes (due 2027-03-24).
- Sean: Deliver on-prem sizing matrix + smoke-test plan (due 2027-03-26).
- Neha: Draft retention/purge scripts and sample audit export (due 2027-03-25).
- Samantha: Confirm procurement timeline and any mandatory vendor questionnaires (due 2027-03-24).

Attaching MAP_FinSecure_v0.3.xlsx (draft).

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@finsecure.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinSecure MAP: deployment & retention questions

On Fri, Mar 19, 2027 at 09:22, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> - VPC: Supported. We offer a Private control plane with customer-managed KMS; we'll need a connectivity/peering doc and a shared runbook for key rotation.

Hi Samantha — quick follow-up from security/product side:

- FedRAMP: to be explicit, we don't currently hold a FedRAMP authorization. What we can provide immediately: SOC 2 Type II report, encryption-in-transit/at-rest documentation, and a technical runbook for VPC peering + KMS integration. If you need an assessment aligned to FedRAMP controls, we can commit to a gap analysis and a remediation plan as part of the MAP.
- Data residency: for VPC and Private deployments we can pin inference nodes to a region (US-East or US-West) and provide the export schema for logs (JSONL).

I'll prepare the KMS checklist and the SOC2 evidence summary (SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf) for the Monday checkpoint.

— Lauren
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@finsecure.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: FinSecure Procurement <procurement@finsecure.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinSecure MAP: deployment & retention questions

Thanks — that addresses most of Procurement's quick concerns. A couple of clarifications before the MAP kickoff:

- Procurement requires a statement that token-level retention can be disabled for the test and that the purge flow can be initiated on demand (they prefer a documented API call). Can you include the exact API endpoint and a rollback plan?
- For on-prem sizing, our infra team prefers to see expected GPU memory use and an I/O profile for 1k tokens. If possible include an H100 and an A40 config in the sizing matrix.
- Timeline: Procurement has an internal review Mar 29 and then a commercial review on Apr 15. They still expect a decision by May 15, but earlier is obviously better.

We agree to the weekly Monday checkpoint. I'll invite our security engineer (cc'd in a later invite) and procurement will join when docs are ready.

Samantha
